changes.before: The selected causative ያስተርእይ and accusative ቤተ are rendered make the house visible, with the righteous and chosen one as singular agent. The following negative verb is plural: they will not be hindered. That plural is not silently converted to a singular house, nor is an unprinted group or a historical identification of the chosen one supplied. The starred selected constructions remain critical qualifications rather than manuscript certification.
changes.after: The selected text prints contracted ያስተርኢ and the longer expression ምስትጉብኤ, not the substituted synonym ማኅበሩ. Actual primary Dillmann1173 gives the corresponding longer noun family with congregatio as a sense; the selected inflected form is retained, not replaced by the dictionary head spelling. Assembly renders that noun family here. The causative appearance construction with accusative ቤተ is rendered make the house visible. The following negative verb is plural: they will not be hindered. No singular house-subject is substituted for that plural, and no historical identity of the righteous/chosen one or an unprinted group is supplied. The selected stars remain visible; these editorial constructions are not a new manuscript certification.
